Chief_Complaint.content: 3-day history of watery diarrhea approximately 5–6 times per day

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Three-day history of watery diarrhea occurring about 5–6 times per day
Initial vomiting occurred twice and has resolved
Felt warm with a bit of temperature at the start of illness but now feels fine
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Felt warm/“bit of temperature” at start; now feels fine

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is trying to drink fluids and feels dehydrated
Minimal solid food intake with poor appetite
Symptom onset occurred while at home working
No known food triggers; denies takeaway or dodgy food
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: no known food triggers (denies takeaway/dodgy food)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Otherwise feels fit and well apart from current illness

Family_History.content: Father died of bowel cancer about 10 years ago

Social_and_Family_History.content: Has been off work for the last 3 days
Alcohol use is infrequent and social

Assessment.content: Acute gastroenteritis characterized by 3-day watery diarrhea, prior vomiting now resolved, no blood in stool, no abdominal pain, early subjective fever, weakness, poor intake, and feeling dehydrated
Assessment.source_text: 1) Acute gastroenteritis — 3d watery diarrhea; prior vomiting resolved; no blood or abdo pain; early subjective fever; weakness; poor intake; feels dehydrated

Plan_of_Care.content: Encourage plenty of fluids and oral rehydration solution such as Dioralyte
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Hydration: Encourage plenty fluids; oral rehydration (Dioralyte)

Plan_of_Care.content: Use paracetamol for fever and weakness
Continue time off work for 1–2 days and return when diarrhea-free for 24–48 hours
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Work: Continue time off 1–2 days; return when diarrhea-free 24–48h

Follow_up_Information.content: If not better by next week, return for review
Follow_up_Information.source_text: F/U: If not better next week, return for review

Review_of_Systems.content: Felt warm with a bit of temperature at the start of illness but now feels fine
Review_of_Systems.source_text: Felt warm/“bit of temperature” at start; now feels fine
